                                      Resolution 2023-24
                        Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors
                          RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT
                      FOR THE GIRDWOOD TRAILS PLAN

   WHEREAS, the Girdwood Trails Plan project began in 2019, initiated when proposed additional trail development was deterred by
     lack of such a plan to guide trail development in the Girdwood Valley; and

   WHEREAS, since 2019 the Girdwood Trails Plan Subcommittee and the Girdwood Trails Committee have met extensively in public
    and collaboratively produced the draft Girdwood Trails Plan, the first plan addressing new trails, trail systems and pedestrian
     connectivity collectively; and

   WHEREAS, the Girdwood Trails Plan was approved by the Girdwood Trails Committee by a vote of 50 in favor, 10 opposed and 5
     abstaining at the January 3 2023 Girdwood Trails Committee regular meeting; and

   WHEREAS, the Girdwood Trails Plan received support from the Girdwood Land Use Committee by a vote of 16 in favor, 1 opposed
     at their regular meeting on February 13, 2023 and unanimous support Girdwood Board of Supervisors at its meeting on February 20,
    2023; and

   WHEREAS, the Girdwood Trails Plan received support from the Heritage Land Bank Advisory Committee at their May 2023 meeting
    and received unanimous support of the Anchorage Planning and Zoning Commission at their regular meeting on November 6, 2023;
    and

   WHEREAS, the Girdwood Trails Plan received some recommendations during the municipal review process, which have been
    addressed in the version now under consideration; and

   WHEREAS, the Girdwood Trails plan has been considered, revised and improved throughout this extensive public process, and is a
     great accomplishment of this dedicated community of outdoor enthusiasts, providing guidance and support for trail construction and
    improvements in the future;

   THEREFORE, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors resolves its continued support for the Girdwood Trails Plan and encourages the
    Anchorage Assembly to vote to adopt this plan.

    Passed and approved by a vote of 4 to 0 on this 18th day of December, 2023.




   Guy Wade
   GBOS Parks and Recreation Supervisor                                Attest
